sections.title: Added
items: Settings → Updates shows the installed build’s release channel so you can tell a private beta from a public release.

sections.title: Changed
items: DiskPlain is now Andromeda, with a blue-to-purple galaxy icon.
The in-app logo displays in color when its window is active and in grayscale when it is inactive.
Andromeda keeps the settings, history, and archives from earlier versions.
This is the first public release. Install it once from the public download to switch from an earlier private beta to the new update feed.

sections.title: Added
items: Organise a Folder can now preview and apply moves inside a selected cloud folder. The preview explains that moves can sync to your other devices.
History can put moved files back. Any folders created by the plan stay in place.
Online-only files are listed as needing a download before Andromeda can organise them.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Sidebar sizes stay aligned to the right when category names wrap.

sections.title: Added
items: Open **What’s New** from Settings or Sparkle’s Version History button to read release notes in Andromeda.
See total disk space for all matches in Scan a Folder, including results beyond the first page.
Undo a single move or remove an unchanged copy from History. Protect project folders from Move to Cloud suggestions.

sections.title: Improved
items: Folder scans continue when you switch pages. Storage Map prepares during Scan This Mac, keeps its results, and shows small items’ names and sizes on hover.
Overview separates the sum of file allocations from macOS used space and points to detected shared storage.
Settings has a curved sidebar, six visible categories, and neutral highlights. The main sidebar keeps long names readable, and first-run setup offers US or UK spelling.
Andromeda has a new folder icon and clearer labels for cloud and external archive tools.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Device Support and other unverified cleanup entries show **Report only** for the installed macOS version.

sections.title: Fixed
items: External Archives can verify copies and restore files when macOS adds its own provenance metadata to a new file or folder.

sections.title: Improved
items: What changed? puts the largest changes first and opens Space Plan from a folder you’ve added.
Cleanup review shows the exact target path and explains how to put files back from History.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Scan a Folder reads `/private/tmp` and `/tmp`.

sections.title: Improved
items: External Archives puts matching files first, names the drive to connect, and links to a verified restored file.
